items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is allowed. Volumes go to the p20 for 20 µL or less and the p300 for more (e.g. p300 for 106, 40 and 250 µL; p20 for 1–19 µL). All measured checks pass, with no overfilled wells and the correct labware.
Every transfer uses new_tip='always' and every mix is wrapped in pick_up_tip/drop_tip. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all pass.

All 33 steps appear in order with the exact quantities and sources/destinations. The manual steps are recorded with protocol.comment. The only free choice is the 10 µL mix volume in step 24, which the task leaves open.

The master mix (106/40/4/2 µL, mixed 5× at 100 µL) is made in D1. 19 µL goes to each of A1:G1, then 2.5 µL forward primer, 2.5 µL reverse primer and 1 µL template from A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1 in order, mixed 3× at 15 µL. The pcr_plate end-state check passes.
19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI go to A1:G1, mixed 3× at 30 µL. The 37/65°C incubation and the Zymo cleanup are recorded with comments in order.

Each assembly well gets 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3 µL fragment 2, 2 µL fragment 5, 3 µL fragment 6, 2 µL of fragments 1/3/4/7 and 1 µL enzyme mix (mixed 5×), totalling 20 µL. The assembly_plate check passes.

The Golden Gate program and the cleanup are recorded with comments. 5 µL of assembly goes to cells A1:D1, then the ice/heat-shock comment, then 250 µL LB to each well, then the recovery and plating comments. The cells_plate check passes.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and every measured check passes. It follows all 33 steps in order with the correct volumes, fresh tips throughout, and the manual steps recorded as comments.
